{{Quote|Well, well. What have we here?''"<br />"''I think, my brother, this little Jedi plans to disrupt our modest operation.''"<br />"''That certainly won't do, will it, Vinoc?''"<br />"''I'm afraid you're right, Karoc. Not at all!|Vinoc and Karoc|<ref name="NDA"/>}}
'''Karoc''' a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was the twin brother of [[Vinoc]] and a [[Dark Acolyte/Legends|Dark Acolyte]] of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and his brother Vinoc were both assigned by Count Dooku to protect the [[C-B3 cortosis battle droid/Legends|cortosis droid]] factories on [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]]. Unfortunately for them, the Dark Acolytes were confronted by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who defeated them both in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] duel.

{{Char-stub}}

==Powers and abilities==
Karoc fought in sync with his twin brother. He employed elements of what resembled [[Form III/Legends|Soresu]] and [[Form II/Legends|Makashi]].<ref name="NDA"/>
